_doc: Threats (SecurityManager). Heat levels with what each brings (never combat). Theft happens at night: chance from heat, district danger, criminal reputation, insiders, waiting customers' traits, unhappy staff, hostile factions; security upgrades lower it. Each theft opens a case you can investigate (cameras, questioning staff, asking around) and resolve by confronting a suspect. The clinic itself is never damaged.

levels.label: MEDIUM
levels.text: Drones linger. Inspectors know your street.

levels.label: HIGH
levels.text: Security is asking questions about you by name.

levels.label: CRITICAL
levels.text: They're building a case. They'll come for what you have.

loot_text.belongings: the photo frame and lighter from your desk

customer.label: A patient who was here today

medium.subject: Somebody is watching the clinic
medium.body: A drone has parked on the roof across the alley three nights running. Patients are noticing.

high.subject: Security wants a word
high.body: Two corporate security officers sit you down in a car outside. They want names: who sells you chrome, who you patch up.

critical.subject: Confiscation order
critical.body: Security has a warrant for 'unregistered medical devices'. They'll be here in an hour. Your black-market stock and anything you're storing is on the list.
